I made an Indian Cricket Stadium tierlist

I'm going to do this by viewing quality for BCCI matches.   
Goated: Wankhede (the vibes and the atmosphere amazing 🤩), Mohali (the grass is so good + it has great camera angles, applies for both old and new 😎), Dharamashala (the scenery is amazing and the groundwork has actually significantly improved 😍), Chennai/Pune (The stands feel so modern and both their grass is really clean, reminds me of open Australian grounds 😁) 

Amazing: Ahmedabad (it is an architectural marvel and the 2026 t20wc victory has ended its 'panoti' status altho the lingering memory of 2023 still hurts 🥲) 

   
Iconic: Eden Gardens (It is an amazing ground with a massive legacy but it is in need of a renovation + boundaries are way too small 🫠), Chinaswammy (same critiques as eden gardens, it has the best drainage in the world which makes cancelled games here quite rare, the ground needs an expansion as such a low capacity is simply not enough for a tier 1 city like bangalore 😫) and Jaipur (the stadium is amazing but it is beginning to show its age through wear and tear 😔)
